== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Under Attack (Japanese)|Under Attack]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/1998-decipher-star-wars-ccg-japanese-hoth-robert-john/imagegallery/32924 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/157878142/-9jiJMTbgE27VMS62eZYDg.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 157878142.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>0b22d11d296a630033d12457359c26bef655d791b78343ded5e25d25c3448b5c</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
